Remember that usable AC energy is typically around 85% of the rated battery capacity after inverter losses.

**Important:** A 2,000Wh power station does not automatically mean it can run your rooftop RV air conditioner. You need sufficient continuous output, startup surge capability, and compatible RV connections. A soft-start device may also be necessary.

Also, a TT-30 outlet on a 2,400W power station does not provide the full 30A service of a campground hookup.
